test.create_query: CREATE TABLE jit_date_start_of (t DateTime('UTC'), t_ny DateTime('America/New_York'), t_kathmandu DateTime('Asia/Kathmandu'), d Date) Engine = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO jit_date_start_of SELECT toDateTime('2010-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + cityHash64(number) % 500000000, toDateTime('2010-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + cityHash64(number, 1) % 500000000, toDateTime('2010-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') + cityHash64(number, 2) % 500000000, toDate('2010-01-01') + cityHash64(number, 3) % 6000 FROM numbers(50000000)
test.query: SELECT countIf(toStartOfMinute(t) = t OR toStartOfMinute(t) < t - 30) FROM jit_date_start_of SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(toStartOfDay(t_ny) > t_ny - 43200) FROM jit_date_start_of SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(toStartOfHour(t) = toStartOfFifteenMinutes(t)) FROM jit_date_start_of SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(toStartOfTenMinutes(t_kathmandu) = toStartOfFiveMinutes(t_kathmandu)) FROM jit_date_start_of SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(toStartOfDay(d) < t) FROM jit_date_start_of SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT countIf(toDate(t_ny) = d) FROM jit_date_start_of SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
SELECT sum(toUnixTimestamp(t) % 1000 + 1) FROM jit_date_start_of SETTINGS compile_expressions = {compile}
